Remark
[Domain of dependence, regularity, and Huygens' principle] ↗ thm:wave-equation-odd-dimensions-solution ↗ thm:wave-equation-dalembert-solution 1. ch2:2.4.1-rem-2\group Wave Equation

For odd $n\ge 3$, $u(x,t)$ depends only on the data and their required derivatives on $\partial B(x,t)$. Unlike the one-dimensional formula, (31) uses derivatives of $g$, so wave evolution does not improve regularity. Both formulas exhibit finite propagation speed.
